# Hawkins Siding and Exteriors — Call Wins Log

Day-by-day log of every ads-generated, recorded CallRail call for Hawkins Siding and Exteriors (Google Ads / Google LSA / Website-pool calls with a gclid or an ads source, transcribed locally with faster-whisper — no cloud ASR), 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-15, 26 calls total.

**Caveat:** names, spellings and small details come from an auto-generated transcript on phone-quality audio — treat odd spellings as transcription noise, not fact. CallRail's caller-ID city field is a phone-geolocation guess and often doesn't match the property address given on the call.

**Outcome legend:** ✅ Booked · ⏳ Open/follow-up needed · ❌ Not a lead · ⚠️ IVR-only (no live conversation captured)

### Post-fix read (10-16 → 10-19, added 2026-10-19)
All 4 Google Ads calls after the 10-16 fixes were non-leads (2 materials buyers, 1 existing-customer down-payment complaint, 1 hang-up). The 60s rule filtered the hang-up, but the other 3 ran past 60s and likely account for the 3 "Calls from ads" conversions logged 10-16 → 10-19. NB search terms still ~75% off-target ($116 of $154 visible: suppliers, Angi, Dabella, stone veneer, "venta de siding"). The 3 keywords moved to phrase got $0; spend moved to the remaining broad keywords (siding repair near me $102, exterior siding contractors $75, vinyl siding $52). LSA: 1 message lead, booked. Only 4 days incl. a weekend.

| Outcome | Count | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ Booked | 8 (1 cancelled same day) | Nick Roye (10-05), Renee Keith (10-08), Dee/Dinh (10-08), Brittney Brown (10-09), Richard Smith (10-10, **cancelled same afternoon**), Deirdre Painter (10-12), Rod Ghasani (10-12, time tbc), Cindy Chun (10-14) |
| ⏳ Open | 6 | Spanish-speaking new-home lead (10-01), Mitch Wagner urgent pipe-damage complaint (10-06), Jackson/Mesquite small repair (10-10), Richard Smith's same-day cancellation (10-10), Brittney Brown's earlier voicemail (10-09, resolved by her own next call), Teresa Morberg partial-repair callback (10-15) |
| ❌ Not a lead | 11 | Wrong numbers/wrong companies (BE Builder Supply, Palestine, Lowe's/James Hardy x2), Tina Humphrey wrong-company confusion + redial, Houston subcontractor inquiry, 3 greeting-only/no-content hang-ups (Athens, Mario Aguillar, Brooke Leblanc), Jose Tapia double-greeting |
| ⚠️ IVR-only | 1 | Houston 06:25am call that only reached the voicemail greeting |

**Flag for Edu:** The good news is real — 7 jobs are standing as booked estimates (plus one more pending its exact time slot), spanning full siding replacements, fascia repair, stucco/trim work, and a condensation/moisture job, and intake is handling detailed, multi-step booking calls competently (collecting address, email, source, and offering material options). But the bad outweighs the good on raw call quality: 11 of 26 ads-attributed calls (42%) were not leads at all — wrong numbers, a wrong-company mix-up, James Hardy/vendor confusion, a subcontractor inquiry, and several calls where the line picked up and nobody said anything before hanging up — plus 1 call that never got past the voicemail greeting. That's real ad spend paying for noise. Two things need a closer look regardless of lead-gen performance: Mitch Wagner's 10-06 call is an existing customer reporting that a Hawkins crew drove nails into a water pipe during installation, with water actively leaking inside and outside his house — this is a liability/reputation issue, not a sales metric, and it's worth confirming Joe Miller actually called him back. And Richard Smith's 10-10 booking got cancelled by the same caller hours later, so that win shouldn't be counted at face value without a rebooking. Separately, worth a sanity check: the 10-15 Teresa Morberg call never collected a property address and her caller ID geolocates to Oregon — before a consultant drives out, confirm the job is actually in Hawkins' Texas service area.

*Oct 16–17 calls added 2026-10-17 (day sections above); the tally table covers Oct 1–15.*
